page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Brachiosaurus?

The Bioluminescent Brachiosaurus is a genetically modified hybrid cephalopod/dinosaur of Brachiosaurus and cuttlefish that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A bioluminescent variant of the Brachiosaurus appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.
